timeline.message:
Fix SearchableSnapshotsCanMatchOnCoordinatorIntegTests

Index at least 1 document on the searchable snapshot, otherwise
the IndexMetadata timestamp range is empty.

Fixes #66774
timeline.author: Francisco Fernández Castaño

timeline.body:
Index at least 1 document on the searchable snapshot, otherwise
the IndexMetadata timestamp range is `EMPTY`.

Closes #66774
I am not entirely sure I follow why we need docs in this test?

reply.body: We assert (https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/67029/files#diff-70b2205b5049ff2a1de6ce21392782676a7aea41ae71e35269e1ee9d3a734ba2R186) that the timestamp range is not `EMPTY` when we index data with a timestamp, so we need to index at least 1 document. It solves the same problem as in the other test.

timeline.body: I have a question, otherwise looking good.
